strings.name: SP_376_OHYOURE_THE_ONE_THATLL_TAKE_CARE_OF_MY_BABY_CAN_YOU_HEAR_ME_I_AM_A_WIZARD_WHO_IS

That kid...is a magical animal that I've poured life into by pouring the Water of Life at the doll that I've made myself. For the longest time, I've been studying and researching on life itself, and learned to actually create a spell that creates life. But it's only possible with the Water of Life...and since it comes out so little, I can only give that kid a life for so long...

strings.name: SP_377_WHEN_THE_TIME_PASSES_AND_THE_WATER_OF_LIFE_THATS_BEEN_SPRINKLED_ONTO_IT_DRIES_UP

.And for that, I collect the Water of Life everyday here deep in the underground. I sent my apprentice up overground, so there comes a time where you'll need the Water of Life, please go visit him. Don't forget that the Water of Life will last once poured onto the doll...Please take care of it...

strings.name: SP_3498_HELLO_IM_FREDRICK_THE_UNION_CHIEF_OF_THE_HIRED_MERCHANT_UNION_THE_WAY_TO_USE_HIR
strings.text:
Hello. I'm Fredrick, the Union Chief of the Hired Merchant Union. The way to use Hired Merchants is really not that different from using a regular store, so you need not worry. There are a few things you'll need to be aware of, however, so please read this contract of agreement VERY carefully before hiring the Merchants.

Hired Merchant Contract
1) According to the points stated below, Hired Merchants disappear after storing your items and mesos at the Store Bank.
  - If the Hired Merchant works at the same spot for more than #r24 Hours#k straight, #rthe Hired Merchant's contract will expire, and the Merchant will disappear.#k
  - #rIf the inventory is full#k, the Hired Merchant will be removed from its post (executes after 1st warning)
2) After Hired Merchant disappears, you'll need to see #rFredrick#k, who's at the Free Market Entrance, and retrieve your items and mesos.
3) You will not be able to hire Merchants until you have retrieved all of your mesos and items.
4) A 1% storing fee of the total sales and original price of the item will be charged daily to the user storing the mesos and items at the Store Bank past #r24 hours#k.
5) Once the storing fee exceeds 100%, the mesos and items stored will be donated to the Free Market Fund.
6) GM's hold the right to change the name of the store without notice if it contains vulgar, inappropriate language.
7) Players can have only one Hired Merchant set up at a time.
